ns3:test-set.name: fn-filter
ns3:test-set.ns3:description: Tests for the higher-order fn:filter function

ns3:test-case.name: filter-001
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: Basic test using starts-with()
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: filter(("apple", "pear", "apricot", "advocado", "orange"),starts-with(?, "a"))

ns3:test-case.name: filter-002
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: Test using an inline user-defined function
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: filter((12, 4, 46, 23, -8), function($x){$x gt 10})

ns3:test-case.name: filter-003
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: Test using an inline user-defined function
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: let $data := (/employees) return filter($data/emp, function($x as element(emp)){xs:int($x/@salary) lt 300})

ns3:test-case.name: filter-004
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: Test using an inline user-defined function
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: (1 to 20)[. = filter(1 to position(), function($x){$x idiv 2 * 2 = $x})]

ns3:test-case.name: filter-005
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: implement eg:index-of-node()
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: let $index-of-node := function($seqParam as node()*, $srchParam as node()) as xs:integer* { filter( 1 to count($seqParam), function($this as xs:integer) as xs:boolean {$seqParam[$this] is $srchParam} ) }, $nodes := /*/*, $perm := ($nodes[1], $nodes[2], $nodes[3], $nodes[1], $nodes[2], $nodes[4], $nodes[2], $nodes[1]) return $index-of-node($perm, $nodes[2])

ns3:test-case.name: filter-006
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: Filter returns an untyped node that can be cast to boolean
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: filter((1 to 20), function($i){{1 - ($i mod 2)}})

ns3:test-case.name: filter-007
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: Map used as filter
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: filter((4, 5, 6), map{4: true(), 5: false(), 6: true()})

ns3:test-case.name: filter-008
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: Array used as filter
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: filter((4, 5, 6), [1, 2, 3, true(), false(), true()])

ns3:test-case.name: filter-901
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: filter function - not a boolean
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: filter(("apple", "pear", "apricot", "advocado", "orange"), normalize-space#1)

ns3:test-case.name: filter-902
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: filter function - returns empty sequence
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: filter(("apple", "pear", "apricot", "advocado", "orange"), function($x){if(starts-with($x,'a')) then true() else ()})

ns3:test-case.name: filter-902a
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: filter function - returns empty sequence
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: filter(("apple", "pear", "apricot", "advocado", "orange"), function($x){if(starts-with($x,'a')) then true() else ()})

ns3:test-case.name: filter-903
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: filter function - returns non-singleton sequence
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: filter( ("apple", "pear", "apricot", "advocado", "orange"), function($x){if(starts-with($x,'a')) then (true(), true()) else false()})

ns3:test-case.name: filter-904
ns3:test-case.ns3:description: filter function - item in sequence is of wrong type
ns3:test-case.ns3:test: filter(("apple", "pear", "apricot", "advocado", "orange", current-date()), ends-with(?, 'e'))
